comments.text:
Implement SynthSwitch, SynthSelect, and SectionPanel Vizia views.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.6 (Vizia editor)

SYNTHSWITCH: Multi-state toggle with LED indicator
- 2-state: horizontal toggle button with LED dot
- N-state: vertical list of options with LED dots
- Properties: value, options (value+label pairs), led flag, led color

SYNTHSELECT: Styled dropdown
- Properties: value, options (value+label pairs), label
- Visual: dark themed dropdown matching the web app style

SECTIONPANEL: Bordered panel container with accent-colored header
- Properties: label text, accent color
- Visual: rounded border, colored top bar, dark background

REFERENCE:
- web/src/synth-ui/SynthSwitch.tsx + .module.css
- web/src/synth-ui/SynthSelect.tsx + .module.css
- web/src/synth-ui/SectionPanel.tsx + .module.css

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/.

title: VST/Vizia: implement SynthSwitch, SynthSelect, and SectionPanel
